dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: Inventory refers to the production of 1 kg rape seed, at farm with a moisture content of 6 %. Fresh matter yield at 12% moisture: 1258 kg/ha.; UUID: 8b3db3b1-247a-327a-90c1-7136bc75da77

time.common:timeRepresentativenessDescription: The yield data have been collected for the years 2001-2006.

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
Conventional production typical for the country. Water for irrigation is pumped from 48 meter depth by electric pumps.

# Included processes
The inventory includes the processes of soil cultivation, sowing, weed control, fertilisation, pest and pathogen control and harvest. Machine infrastructure and a shed for machine sheltering is included. Inputs of fertilisers, pesticides and seed as well as their transports to the farm are considered. The direct emissions on the field are also included. The system boundary is at the farm gate.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: Data come from the NREL database and from varoius U.S database. Data were compiled from statistics, literature, farm survey reports, documents from extension services, and expert knowledge.

review.common:reviewDetails: Proof reading validation: automatic validation in Excel; Other validation: none;
